data.name: Dhira
data.gender_notes: Dhira is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhīrā’ meaning ‘firm, steady, or stable’. In Hindu mythology, Dhira is a name for the goddess Durga, symbolizing her unwavering courage and strength. The name Dhira carries the meaning “Firm, Steady” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhira usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhira belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, Steady.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhira total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
